title: People’s Mañanera August 20
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Olinia: Mexican Creativity Transformed into Technology  
** With 70 specialists from the National Polytechnic Institute (IPN), the
National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), and TecNM, Olinia is moving
forward with a majority of Mexican capital, leaving behind the neoliberal view
of Mexico as a source of cheap labor. “At its core, it’s about believing in
Mexico and in Mexicans,” President Claudia Sheinbaum said.

**Strong Peso: Confidence in the Mexican Economy  
** Despite the global changes caused by U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs,
Mexico maintains a solid economy, with growth in employment and investment.
Sheinbaum emphasized that “if there was no confidence internationally, the
peso wouldn’t be where it is today.”

**The PAN Wants to Take “The School is Ours” Program Away from Families  
** In response to the PAN’s proposal to strip parents’ direct control over
resources and transfer it to municipalities, the President defended the
current model. Less than 1% have had administrative issues. “It’s an excellent
program—wonderful,” Sheinbaum said.

**“It is a privilege to serve the people”  
** Nearly two years into her administration, Sheinbaum summarized her vision
of public service. “It is a privilege to serve the people. Those are the good
privileges—not the ones that were abused in the past,” she explained.

**Audience Rights: More Democracy, Not Censorship  
** The new guidelines will include a code of ethics, an audience ombudsman,
and complaint mechanisms, following dialogue with various sectors. Sheinbaum
announced that they could be presented next week: “It’s a step forward for
democracy in our country,” she explained.

**Disinformation Networks: Sovereignty, Not Interference  
** Following the arrest of Fernando Cerimedo, Javier Negre’s partner at La
Derecha Diario, for attempted femicide against his wife, the President
confirmed that his group operates in Mexico and pointed out the use of bots to
amplify disinformation. In light of possible ties to foreign agencies, she
said that “they must respect Mexico. No intervention, no interference.”
